pages.text: You can find Hazelnuts growing on birch trees throughout Birch Forests which can be used as a more efficient method of creating Chocolate. You can replant these nuts to grow back into trees for a renewable source of both wood and Hazelnuts.
Occasionally in Birch Forests, birch trees will have a log leaking some Birch Sap. Right-click with an Empty Glass Bottle to harvest it for further processing.
